summary: Iteration 2: validated Phase 2 fixes (checkout auto-focus, prefill enables Continue, order success toast, notification stub) and features (Search page, Account login + My Account). 36/36 backend tests pass (31 previous + 5 new for notificationReceipts, /customers/{phone}/profile, /customers/{phone}/orders). Frontend E2E covered all 6 review items — all critical passes. One minor UX bug: logout ends on /account/login instead of /.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking data-testid=account-logout, the user lands on /account/login instead of /. Root cause: <Navigate to='/account/login' replace /> fires the moment logout() flips isAuthed to false and replaces history before the explicit navigate('/') in doLogout runs. Session is correctly cleared and toast 'Signed out' shows, but the spec requires redirect to /. Fix: navigate('/', { replace: true }) BEFORE calling logout(), or guard the Navigate render to only apply when phone was never set (e.g., an initial-mount ref).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix logout redirect so /account/logout returns user to / instead of /account/login (race between <Navigate> and navigate('/')).
critical_code_review_comments: AccountPage useEffect: if 401 comes back, it does logout() + navigate('/account/login') INSIDE .catch — fine, but combined with the top-of-render <Navigate to='/account/login' /> it can cause double-navigation. Consider consolidating.
notifications.py send_order_confirmation swallows exceptions per channel — good. Consider adding a message-id/uuid per receipt for future dedup when a real provider is wired in.

AccountContext stores raw phone in localStorage — acceptable for Phase 1 (no PII beyond phone), but note that backend re-checks otp_requests.verified on every profile/orders fetch so client-side tampering only allows access to phones that were previously OTP-verified in this DB. This is the correct trust boundary.
